Title: Kidnap, Rivers
Description: A DSS personnel, Reuben Uzoma, was abducted alongside his family and killed by his abductors. He was shot from a close range by one of the kidnappers after he killed 2 of them.
Protagonists: armed gangs, other governmental security forces

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Bayelsa
Description: 3 kidnappers were shot dead along the waterways by troops of the Joint Task Force (JTF) code-named Operation Delta Safe (ODS). It was reported that the gang of kidnappers opened fire on the soldiers but where overcome by the troops.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Niger
Description: 2 notorious kidnappers, who were terrorising an area, were shot dead by policemen who intercepted them on a highway. It was reported that the kidnappers specialised in abducting high profile individuals.

Title: Kidnappers vs Nursing Mother, Imo
Description: A nursing mother was murdered by a gang of 4 kidnappers.The assailants went away with the victim's 5-month-old baby with the intention of selling it for N300,000. Some suspects including Uchenna Ozor, Prince Etim John, Chinazaepkeren Nwaenyi and Chukwudi Ngbanwelu were arrested in connection with the crime. The event is backdated by 1 week because of the manner it was reported.

Title: Kidnap, Kogi
Description: 24-year-old Grace Onaivi, a 300 Level student of International Relations at Kogi State University, Ayingba, who was kidnapped and killed by Sanusi Jubril, 33; Caleb Moses, 28; Nuhu Musa a.k.a Black Mudi Sali, 33.

Title: Kidnapper vs Dangote staff, Ogun
Description: A staff of Dangote Industries Limited, Mr Istifanus Bello was killed by suspected kidnappers including Abubakar Gide, Abdullahi Salihu and Babuga Adamu. The victim's corpse was discovered in a gutter after 3 weeks he was kidnapped.

Title: Kidnap, Osun
Description: A missing student, Adebisi Rifiat Damilola of Osun State University was found dead. The decease was a student of Science Education at the Ipetu-Ijesa campus of the Institution and went to attend a NASFAT programme when she was declared missing. A herbalist and a driver were later arrested for the kidnap and murder of the student. Mr. Elijah Oyebode and Yusuf Ajibad were later arrested for the murder. The victim was killed for ritual purpose.
Sources of information: Daily Trust (1 ) , The Punch (1 ) , New Telegraph (1 )

Title: Kidnappers vs Girl, Kebbi
Description: A 3-man kidnap gang raped a 17-year-old girl, Zahara'a Bello to death. The hoodlums attacked the victim when she was going to her sister's house to pass the night.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed by the Police during a joint operation by the police and vigilantes. It was reported that 2 female victims of the kidnappers were rescued during the operation.

Title: Abducted Lecturer, Kogi
Description: A female lecturer, Mrs Christiana Agbulu of the Department of Bological Sciences, University of Agriculture, Makurdi was kidnapped and killed by her abductors: Sanusi Jubril, 33; Caleb Moses, 28; Nuhu Musa a.k.a Black Mudi Sali, 33 when she travelled to visit a frien in Kogi state. She was kidnapped on November 6 and her decomposing body discovered BY 4th Jaunary 2017.

Title: Kidnap, Rivers
Description: 2 people were killed by gunmen suspected to be cultists during the kidnap of a former LGA caretaker committee, Mr. Jeremiah Uche. The victims were Mr. Uche's visitors. Among them is one Mr. Julius Amadi, a former youth president.

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed during a shootout with troops of 144 Battalion, Asa. It was reported that the criminals were killed when soldiers rescued a kidnapped Dubai-based Nigeria. The date of the incident was not stated but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police kill Kidnappers, Lagos
Description: Dr Ajayi, a medical doctor with St Francois Hospital, Onikan was kidnapped by a gang of kidnapper and was rescued by police team. In the process, there was gun dual between the policemen and gang which led to the death of 4 of the kidnappers.
Place: Thick forest in Ibeju Lekki area.

Title: Kidnappers vs Retired Principal, Bayelsa
Description: A 72-year-old retired school Principal, Chief Sunday Festus, was killed by kidnappers. It was reported that the abductors murdered the victim after his family paid a ransom for his release. The decomposing body of the victim was later found.

Title: Kidnappers vs Special Assistant, Enugu
Description: The Special Assistant to the Chairman of the Local Government Area on Security Matters, Mr Ejiofor Enechi, was abducted and killed by a gang of kidnappers. Some of the kidnappers were identified as Thankgod Asogwa and Akakwu Chizoba Collins.

Title: Police vs Kidnapper, Delta
Description: EXTRA JUDICIAL KILLING: Samson Efe, a 41-year-old mechanic, died in the police custody. The victim, who was a kidnap suspect, died in custody due to the injuries he sustained from torture by the police.
Place: Anti-Kidnap Section, Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Delta Police Command

Title: Security Operatives vs Kidnappers, FCT (Abuja)
Description: One operative of the Nigerian Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) died while a kidnapper was shot dead during a clearance operation aimed at routing kidnappers. Several kidnapped victims were rescued in the operation.

Title: Kidnapper, Edo
Description: A kidnapper identified simply as Victor was shot dead by the police while picking ransom for a kidnapped victim. His accomplice was arrested alive. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Bayelsa
Description: A 78-year-old man identified as Dennis Ogazi died in the den of kidnappers. It was reported that some of the kidnappers were identified as David Sunshine and Otuogba Usifo.

Title: Kidnapers vs Man, Imo
Description: The corpse of an abducted business man identified as Mr. Amaechi Ahanonu was found near his village. It was reported that the man was killed after his kidnappers collected a ransom of 500,000 naira. The date of the event was not stated but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnappers, Imo
Description: 3 men led by a notorious kidnapper, Osondu (alias, Galaxy) were burnt to death by youths after a failed kidnap incident. The trio kidnapped a baby boy but were apprehended after the baby's mother raised an alarm.

Title: Kidnappers vs Lectuer, Rivers
Description: A gang of kidnappers abducted and killed a lecturer identified as Emmanuel Chinasa Obi. It was reported that the victim was working in the University of Port Harcourt (UNIPORT) before the abduction.

Title: Kidnappers vs Vigilante, Edo
Description: KIDNAP: A member of a Civil Vigilance Group identified as Gabriel Okorare was killed while the group tried to rescue Mrs Margaret Emefiele, the kidnapped wife of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Governor. The 64-year-old man was shot dead during the rescue mission. Another suspect, Umar Abubakar later died of bullet wounds. According to report, the kidnap of the wife to the CBN boss was aided by 2 soldiers.

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: Troops of Nigeria army killed 7 kidnappers. It was reported that the kidnappers were killed by a fighting patrol team of the 33 Brigade at their hideout in a forest. 2 AK-47 rifles and 3 dane guns were recovered from the hoodlums.
Place: Lame Burra forest near Dursen Ganye, Gunduru and Kati Layin villages

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Imo
Description: Troops of 34 Field Artillery Brigade in the exercise of Operation Crocodile Smile in Niger Delta killed 2 kidnappers. The incident happened when they raided two major kidnappers' camps belonging to De-Well and De-Gbam cultist groups. One of the victims was identified as one Chigozie aka "Chi boy".

Title: Kidnap, Imo
Description: A man was kidnapped, killed and buried in a shallow grave by Ikenna Solomon Agubosi and Benneth Ibe Onyebuchi despite collecting ransom. This incident is backdated to the middle of October last year since no day was reported for the incident.

Title: Soldiers vs Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: 6 kidnappers were killed during a gun battle between the criminals and the soldiers from 33 Brigade Nigerian Army. It was reported that the shootout started when the army encountered the kidnappers.
Sources of information: The Nation (6 ) , This Day (5 ) , Daily Trust (5 )

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: Troops of 33 Brigade Nigerian Army killed 3 armed kidnappers during an operation aimed at flushing out criminal elements from a deadly forest. The army also destroyed the camps of the kidnappers in the forest. Several cache of arms and ammunition were recovered.
Place: Dutsen Mairama and Dogon Ruwa settlement within Lame/Burra Forest

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: A kidnapper was killed by soldiers attached to the 144 Battalion of the Nigerian Army, who stormed their hideout. The victim was part of a 6-man gang of kidnappers who killed a business man, identified as Obinna Ezeononigbo.

Title: Kidnappers, Ondo
Description: 2 police orderlies were shot dead during the kidnap of 2 Chinese technicians. The date and the place were reported. Therefore, this event is backdated by two weeks and situated in the state capital.

Title: Kidnappers vs Manger, Lagos
Description: A gang of kidnappers identified as Idowu Dauwujoh, Idoroh Priye, Daniel Jekene, Kekeminiwei, Afro and Odesebra killed a farm manager identified as a 43-year-old Abiodun Adeniyi. The victim was kidnapped alongside 2 other persons before he was killed.

Title: Vigilantes vs Kidnappers, Taraba
Description: 3 kidnappers were killed during a shootout with vigilantes. The kidnappers numbering about 10 invaded the house of a businessman with the aim of abducting him. They triggered the alarm in the targets residents and alerted the vigilantes who responded immediately.

Title: Kidnappers vs King, Lagos
Description: A gang of kidnappers stormed the palace of the traditional ruler of Iba community and abducted a royal father, Oba Goriola Oseni-the Oniba of Iba land. In the process, Mr. Joseph Okeke, a 72-year-old palace guard, Mr. Sunday Okanlawon and a motorcycle rider were killed. The victims tried to frustrate the kidnapper's escape.

Title: Kidnappers, Gboko
Description: 2 kidnappers were apprehended and burnt alive. Details of the failed kidnap was not reported. However, this incident is backdated by 2 weeks as was carried in the report.

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed by soldiers of the 33 Artillery Brigade while two of the kidnappers were arrested. It was reported that the soldiers came in contact with the armed bandits who opened fire on them, leading to the death of 2 of the kidnappers.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Kaduna
Description: 5 members of a kidnap gang were shot dead during an exchange of gunfire with the police. The victims were among the kidnappers who abducted a Sierra Leonean envoy along Abuja-Kaduna road.

Title: Kidnappers vs Police, Rivers
Description: 3 Mobile Policemen were gunned down by kidnappers. It was reported that the incident happened when the kidnappers abducted two brothers and took them away on a speedboat. The brothers just opened a new boutique in the community,

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Lagos
Description: A man identified as Kolawole Animashaun was kidnapped by Bode Fabiy and Afeez Ahmed. It was reported that the duo killed the victim, sold his car and still demanded for ransom from his family.

Title: Kidnapper, Benue
Description: A kidnapper who abducted a 2-year-old boy was apprehended and set ablaze by an angry mob. Attention of the mob was drawn when the boy was crying uncontrollably and struggling to set himself free. Another source reported that the boy was a 3-months-old son of one Mrs. Blessing Aondoakaa.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 4 people including 2 policemen and 2 kidnappers died in two different locations. The kidnappers, who had earlier killed 2 mobile policemen and made away with their rifles were trailed to their hideout and got killed in the process. While a source reported that 4 policemen died in the incident, another source reported that the shootout was between the police and cultists.

Title: Kidnappers, Niger
Description: A herder, Sama’ila Muhammad, was shot dead while rescuing kidnapped women from their abductors. The victim, in the company of some vigilantes, trailed the kidnappers to their hideout but died in the process.

Title: Police Kill Kidnap Kingpin, Abia
Description: A kidnap kingpin popularly called 'onye Army" was shot dead by the police during a robbery incident. The gang had robbed a man and killed a policeman attached to a bureau de change before running into an ambush laid by the police.

Title: Kidnappers vs Driver, Cross River
Description: A gang of kidnappers killed a driver who was conveying 5 expatriates of MacMahom, a contracting firm with United Cement Company of Nigera (UNICEM) to work. It was reported that the abductors killed the driver for refusing to stop and later kidnapped the 5 expatriates.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Gombe
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed by the Police when they exchanged gunfire. The kidnappers had abducted a 16-year-old-girl when she boarded a commercial vehicle. The date of the event was not stated, it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Gombe
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed by the Police when they exchanged gunfire. The kidnappers had abducted a 16-year-old-girl when she boarded a commercial vehicle. The date of the event was not stated, it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Soldiers vs Rustlers/Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: 3 rustlers/kidnappers were killed by soldiers during an attack on their camp. The soldiers, who on a tip off, killed the rustlers and rescued 3 abducted female victims.

Title: Army vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 4 kidnappers were killed by troops of 2 Brigade Command of the Nigerian Army. The incident happened during an operation targeted at rescuing kidnapped victims. 3 kidnapped victims were freed during the operation.

Title: Kidnapers vs Man, Kogi
Description: A 5-man gang of kidnappers abducted one Alhaji Umar Husseini, killed him and dumped his body in the bush. It was reported that the police later arrested the criminals.

Title: Kidnappers Vs Policemen, Rivers
Description: After a distress call to the police, 5 kidnap/robbery suspects were shot dead by a team of policemen during a shootout.

Title: Kidnappers Vs policemen, Imo
Description: A gun duel between a team of policemen and a gang of kidnappers, who kidnapped a 75-year-old paramount ruler of Ubomini community in Rivers state, on May 28th 2016, led to the death of 3 members of the gang.

Title: Kidnappers, Ogun
Description: 5 people died after kidnappers suspected to be former pipeline vandals opened fire on residents. The kidnappers had come for a business in the neighbourhood but vented their anger on residents. Among the victims is a lawyer.

Title: Kidnap Victim, Kano
Description: 11-year-old boy, Musa Salisu, was found dead after being abducted by a gang of kidnappers. The abductors of the boy killed him when they realized that the police was closing in on them.

Title: Kidnap Woman Victim, Benue
Description: A woman identified as Charity Aba, who was abducted by gunmen in front of her house while waiting for her gate to be opened, was found dead. The victim was found dead with a deep cut on her face.

Title: Kidnap Victim, Imo
Description: A student of the Federal Polytechnic, Nekede identified as Ugonna Martins Ukaegbu was kidnapped and subsequently killed by his friends. The names of the killers were given as Udodi Eke (23 years), Chukwudi Eke (24 years) and Chidiebere Umezurike (20 years). The date of the killing was not reported but due to the nature of the death it backdated by 1 week.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Rivers
Description: A gang of kidnappers led by a 30-year-old Chinedu Azuazu abducted and murdered a man identified as Ikenna Osuji. The victim was a student of Federal Polytechnic, Nekede before his death.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Cross River
Description: A popular bakery owner identified as Mr. Kenneth Anya died in his home after he was released by kidnappers who abducted him for several days. It was reported that his death is connected to the trauma he suffered while in the hands of his abductors.

Title: Kidnappers/Fraudsters vs Man, Osun
Description: Olalekan Ogunranti, the former Managing Director of Today's Prints Limited, was kidnapped and murdered by some fraudsters. It was reported that the fraudsters killed the victim to prevent him from demanding for the large sum of money they fraudlently collected from him. The perpetrators were identified as Asimiyu Agboola, Adesina Muyideen, Ramoni Afolabi, Akeem Akorede and Coker Daniel.

Title: Kidnappers vs DSS, Akwa Ibom
Description: 5 kidnap suspects were arrested in connection with the killing of a personnel of the Department of state Security (DSS) and 3 other victims. Justice Onyekachi, Chidi Christian Nwokoma, Precious Ndidi Alali, Gift Onyegbule Ogbonna and Uche Success Nwokocha. The hoodlums were arrested in Obio/Akpor LGA (Rivers state).

Title: Kidnap Victim, Delta
Description: The manager of a popular filling station on Port Harcourt road was kidnapped and killed after paying a ransom of the sum of 3 million Naira. Due to the nature of the story, this event is backdated by 1 week.

Title: Kidnapped Priest, Benue
Description: The abducted Catholic priest, Reverend Father John Adenyi, Vicar-General of Otukpo Catholic Diocese, was found dead by the police in a bush, a few kilometers away from the main road. The body of the priest, who was kidnapped two months ago, was found already decomposing.The suspects who killed Reverend Father John Adenyi are: Suleiman Goma, 30, leader; Saidu Abdullahi, 28, deputy leader; Aliyu Garba, 26; and Haruna Idi, 27.
Sources of information: Nigerian Tribune (1 ) , The Guardian (1 ) , The Punch (1 )

Title: Kidnap Suspect, Kaduna
Description: A suspected kidnapper who attempted to kidnap a 4-year-old boy was burnt to death. The victim, AlMustapha Aruna was captured in a bag inside a tricycle, Keke NAPEP before he was rescued.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Enugu
Description: Some kidnappers, who belonged to a kidnapping syndicate, were killed by policemen during rescue operations. The kidnappers were responsible for kidnapping a lawyer, John Abugu, Jane Ekweremadu Brooks, Okwara and Sandra Onu. Some of the kidnappers were caught by the police.

Title: Kidnap, Rivers
Description: A National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) member, Mr. Sampson Worlu, was kidnapped and killed after the payment of N1.5 million ransom. 5 people were arrested for the abduction. This event is backdated by a week since no date was reported for the murder.

Title: Kidnappers vs Army Officer, Kaduna
Description: An army officer, Colonel Samaila Inusa, abducted by kidnappers was found dead. It was reported that he was killed the same day he was kidnapped and his body was found in a village.
Place: Ajyaita village off Eastern Bypass, Kaduna

Title: Police vs Armed Robbers/Kidnappers, Enugu
Description: 4 hoodlums were killed in a gun duel with policemen who stormed the hideout of the robbers who also doubled as kidnappers.

Title: Kidnappers, Kaduna
Description: The decomposing body of an abducted pastor and vice president of United Church of Christ in Nigeria (HEKAN), Mr. Anto was found in a bush. The victim was kidnapped alongside 2 others who were later released. The fact that the corpse was already decomposing is indicative that the victim might have been killed a day after his abduction.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Kogi
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed by policemen when the latter stormed the kidnappers' den to rescue a victim, Ms Dora Omale. One of the kidnappers escaped.

Title: Kidnap, Rivers
Description: A National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) member, Mr. Sampson Worlu, was kidnapped and killed after the payment of N1.5 million ransom. 5 people were arrested for the abduction. This event is backdated by a week since no date was reported for the murder.

Title: Police vs Fulani Kidnappers, Niger
Description: 2 Fulani kidnappers were killed during a shoot out with the police as the force men tried to rescue abducted victims from their den. 5 kidnapped victims were rescued from the kidnappers' den. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Kogi
Description: 3 kidnappers were killed by a team of policemen during a shootout between the kidnappers and the forcemen. The kidnappers had been terrorising the area recently as captured in IBD008281. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnappers Kill Man, Benue
Description: A business man, Augustine Muoneme popularly known as Kosta, was shot dead in his residence by kidnappers. The victim was killed by the kidnappers for failing to offer them unspecified amount of money they demanded from him.

Title: Kidnappers vs Soldiers, Bayelsa
Description: 2 soldiers, who were escorts to some expatriates attached to SETRACO construction company were ambushed and killed by kidnappers. The victims were overpowered in a gun duel and shot dead while the expatriates were whisked away. There is a resurgence of kidnapping in the Niger Delta area for some weeks now. This incident happened less than 24 hours 4 kidnappers who abducted a soldiers were killed in a shootout with soldiers.

Title: Kidnapper vs Cattle Owner, Oyo
Description: Harande Ardo, a 50-year-old man was killed by suspected kidnappers, Usman Umaru, Yabani, Smallie and Ube. They killed him and cover him with river sand despite the fact that the victim begged them to spare his life.

Title: Kidnappers vs Vigilantes, FCT (Abuja)
Description: A member of a vigilante group was killed by kidnappers. The victim was killed during a shootout with the gunmen inside a Fulani camp. Another member was kidnapped.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: 3 kidnappers were killed by a team of policemen during an exchange of gunfire. The incident happened while the policemen were rescuing one Mr Ozuem Chukwunalu Romanus who was a victim of kidnapping.

Title: Kidnapped Victim, Bayelsa
Description: Mr. Samuel Oki, a 35-year-old nephew of former President Goodluck Jonathan, was found dead in a creek two days after he was kidnapped. The victim was kidnapped alongside Chief Inengite Nitabai, the 72-year-old foster father of the ex-president.

Title: Kidnappers vs Lecturer, Delta
Description: Isaac Dittimiya, a senior lecturer at the College of Education, Warri, was abducted and murdered by kidnappers after collecting a ransom. His remains was buried in a shallow grave. It was reported that the shock of the lecturer's death led to the sudden death of his father, mother and sister.

Title: Kidnapper vs CBN Staff, Kogi
Description: A staff of the Central bank of Nigeria (CBN), was kidnapped and killed by a gang of kidnappers. The victim's lifeless body was discovered by the road side. It was reported that the event happened on a Sunday in February. Hence, it is assumed to have happened on 14th February.

Title: Kidnapper vs CBN Staff, Kogi
Description: A staff of the Central bank of Nigeria (CBN), was kidnapped and killed by a gang of kidnappers. The victim's lifeless body was discovered by the road side. It was reported that the event happened on a Sunday in February. Hence, it is assumed to have happened on 14th February.

Title: Police vs Kidnapper, Kogi
Description: A kidnapper dressed in Military camouflage was killed by a team of policemen on duty. 3 other victims were rescued during the operation by the police.

Title: Kidnappers killed 3, Katsina
Description: A gang of notorious kidnappers abducted and murdered one Na Uruku and the owner of a petrol station about 2 years ago. A kola nut seller was also killed. The incident was reported with incidents IBD013120 IBD013121

Title: Kidnappers Kill 1, Imo
Description: One Ezinne Ann Nwachukwu, a scribe of Catholic Women Organisation (CWO) of St. Anthony's Catholic Church, Ihitte Ubi was kidnapped and murdered 5 days later.

Title: DSS Vs Kidnappers, Kwara
Description: One Abubakar Mohammed (a.k.a. Buba) was killed during a gun duel between his gang of kidnappers and security operatives. The incident happened when the kidnappers tried to escape.
Protagonists: other governmental security forces, armed gangs

Title: Kidnap, Lagos
Description: A 40-year-old housewife, Helen Peters died after she was abducted by Henry Uwadiegwu. The perpetrator claimed she was insane, hired some hoodlums to tie her up in his house and invited a nurse who injected her with sedative drugs that ended her life.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Akwa Ibom
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed in a gun duel with the police. The victims had kidnapped a 74- year-old woman, Grace Okon Bassey. She got suffocated to death before the police intervention. It is assumed the incident occurred in the state capital since no specific location was reported by the source.

Title: DSS Vs Kidnappers, Kwara
Description: One Abubakar Mohammed (a.k.a. Buba) was killed during a gun duel between his gang of kidnappers and security operatives. The incident happened when the kidnappers tried to escape.
Protagonists: other governmental security forces, armed gangs

Title: Kidnappers, Taraba
Description: A passerby was shot dead by gunmen in the process of kidnapping the aged mother (Mrs. Belli Manu) of Taraba State Deputy Governor, Haruna Manu. The victim was shot on the leg and later died in the hospital.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, FCT (Abuja)
Description: A member of a kidnapping gang was shot dead when he attempted to collect a ransom for the kidnapping of a former speaker of Ondo State House of Assembly, Mr. Victor Olabitan on his way to Abuja.

Title: Kidnap Monarch Vs Fulani Herdsmen, Delta
Description: The body of the kidnapped paramount ruler of Ubulu-Uku Kingdom in Aniocha North Local Government Area of Delta State, His Royal Majesty Akaeze Edward Ofolue III, was recovered. He was kidnapped by Fulani herdsmen along with his driver. A corpse of a Hausa man was also found by in the same bush.

Title: Police vs Kidnapper, Abia
Description: A kidnapper was killed in a gun duel during an attempt to abduct one Chibuike. Different arms and ammunition were recovered from the attackers. This event is backdated by 6 months since it was reported to have happened within a year.

Title: 2 in Kidnap, Rivers
Description: 2 members of a community were shot dead in a sporadic shooting by gunmen in the process of abducting a member of the caretaker committee for Degema local government area, Mrs. Elekima Patson, and her 2-year old son,

Title: Kidnappers Vs Brothers, Bayelsa
Description: A 9-man kidnapping gang shot one Timipre Shally and abducted him and his brother, Weri Shally. Timipre bled to death in the kidnappers' den. The brothers were kidnapped because they for identified one of the men that previously abducted their father.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: The police killed 3 kidnappers during a deadly encounter with the hoodlums. 2 victims were abducted by the criminals but rescued by the police during the incident. Dangerous weapons including AK-47 rifle, local pistols and rounds of ammunitions were recovered from them. The date of the incident was not stated, it is assumed it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Boko Haram Kidnap, Maiduguri
Description: Boko Haram allegedly kills 8 and kidnaps 2 children right in the middle of Maiduguri. Perhaps this incident was not reported in the media because of the pressure of the government, which claimed that Boko Haram was "technically defeated"

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: A deadly encounter between the police and a gang of kidnappers led to the death of 3 abductors. The kidnap victims-bayo David and Iyabi Segun were rescued by the police.
Place: Near Elibrada Junction, Along East-West Road.

Title: Kidnapped Victim's Father, Kogi
Description: Some Fulani men killed one Mallam Isah Yusuf after kidnapping him and collecting ransom because the victim identified one of the kidnappers. The kidnappers killed the father of the Mallam Isah named Mohammed Yusuf in retaliation for exposing one of the kidnappers.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 4 kidnappers were shot dead by the police. The kidnappers had earlier abducted one Ken Livinus but were intercepted by the police. The gang was reported to have been responsible for the killing of a DPO, Cliff Igwegbe (See event in IBD007312)

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: An exchange of gunfire between a team of policemen and a gang of kidnappers led to the death of 3 kidnappers. One of the victims that fell as a result of police superior bullet was named Chukwuemeka Ilo. The date of the event was not stated, it is assumed it happened 2 weeks before it was reported because of the manner the case was presented.

Title: 6 Kidnap Women Victims, Lagos
Description: 6 women were suspected to have been attacked and killed by kidnappers. The victims were thereafter dumped in the canal. Another source reported 9 deaths within a period of 2 weeks.

Title: Kidnap, Delta
Description: A pastor was shot dead by kidnappers, who were trailing of a businessman. This event is backdated by 2 days since the incident was reported to have happened last week.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: A kidnapper (Ifeanyi) was shot dead during a gun duel with the police. He died while receiving treatment in the hospital. The police stormed the kidnapper's hideout after receiving a tip-off on the activities of the criminals.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 2 kidnappers were shot dead by a team of policemen. The incident happened when the police stormed the kidnappers' den where they were guarding 2 hostages. The kidnappers were killed in the gunfire that ensued between them and the police at the waterfront which cuts across two local governments.

Title: Police Kill 4 Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 4 kidnappers were killed by the police during the rescue operation of the kidnapped Registrar of Ken Saro-Wiwa Polytechnic, Mrs. Lilian Davies. The kidnappers were felled when they engaged the police in a shootout.

Title: Kidnappers Vs Driver, Rivers
Description: Kidnappers, who abducted the University of Port Harcourt Director of Sports, Professor Ken Anukweje, shot his driver dead. The driver was assigned to the Professor 2 weeks ago.

Title: Security Forces vs Vandals/Kidnappers, Lagos
Description: 2 people were killed during a gun battle between security forces and pipeline vandals. The clash started when security forces, comprising of soldiers and policemen, tried to free one of their personnel who was kidnapped by the vandals.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 4 kidnappers who were planning to kidnap an agricultural produce buyer were shot dead by a team of policemen during an ambushed on them. One of the deceased was a relative of the man the kidnappers planned to abduct.

Title: Kidnap and Murder, Bayelsa
Description: A retired Major and uncle to a former governor of Bayelsa, Timipre Sylva, Chief Benson Ayerite Adigio-Eseni was kidnapped and murdered. A 27-year-old man was arrested in connection to the incident. The particular Place and LGA were not given but assume it happened in Yenagoa, the state capital.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 3 suspected kidnappers and 1 armed robber were reported to have been killed by the Police during a raid in their hide-out between October and November.

Title: Kidnap, Bayelsa
Description: A 37 years old man, Ebikabowei Umbu, was killed during the kidnap of a popular music icon (Pereama Freetown) during a performance. The victim was killed when the kidnappers shot sporadically into the air.

Title: Kidnappers vs Lecturer, Rivers
Description: Dr. Eeba Lebarile, a lecturer at the University of Port Harcourt (UNIPORT), was kidnapped and killed. The names of the killers were given as 41-year-old Christopher Kinanee (the victim's gate man), 48-year-old Lebari Robert Tambari (an ex-police officer and a cousin of the victim) and 27-year-old Ibrahim Useni (a foreigner from the Republiuc of Benin).
Place: Mercy land Estate Home on East-West Road

Title: Kidnap, Rivers
Description: A 92-year-old man, Elder Gilbert Oriji was kidnapped, murdered and buried in a shallow grave. His corpse was discovered few months after his murder. He had previously been kidnapped and released before the final attempt that claimed his live. The middle of October was abducted as the day of occurrence since none was reported.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Katsina
Description: 1 kidnapper was killed during a shootout between a team of policemen and a 2-man kidnapping gang. The other kidnapper escaped while the police rescued 2 kidnapped teenagers identified as Usman Rabiu (15 years) and Babangida Rabiu (12 years). The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Lady vs Kidnappers, Kogi
Description: A 20-year-old lady was kidnapped and killed by unknown gunmen. The lady had been kidnaped for weeks before her corpse was discorvered last saturday. Her case was reported with the abduction of a royal father, Alhaji Musa Isah Achuja.

Title: Kidnap Victim, Lagos
Description: A woman, Mrs Victoria Ifeoma was kidnapped and killed by her alleged lover, Kingsley Chibuzor. The victim had told her parents she was travelling to Ghana to look for job and was abducted by Kingsley who used her as sex slave until her death.

Title: Police Vs Hoodlums/Kidnappers, Delta
Description: 1 kidnapper was shot dead by a team of policemen. The incident happened when a 5-man kidnappers were abducting their victim and policemen, who responded to a distress call, engaged them in a gunfire. The victim of the kidnappers was rescued. The date of the event was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Soldiers vs Kidnappers, Bauchi
Description: 2 kidnappers were shot dead during a gun duel between them and soldiers from Nigerian Army, 33 Artillery Brigade. It was reported that the soldiers rescued a 16-year-old boy, Muhammad Musa, from the abductors.

Title: 3 Kidnappers, Delta
Description: A team of policemen shot 3 kidnappers dead when they attempted to abduct a returnee from the United Kingdom. The victims were killed in a gun duel.

Title: Kidnappers Kill 1, Sokoto
Description: A 25-year-old man was shot dead by kidnappers who who abducted the 75-year-old mother of the governorship candidate of the defunct All Nigeria Peoples Party (ANPP) during the 2011 elections in Sokoto. 2 other persons were injured in the incident perpetrated by 6 gunmen.

Title: Police Vs Kidnapper, Edo
Description: A team of Edo State Police Command killed a suspected kidnapper during a gun battle between the police and gang of kidnappers. The kidnappers abducted a butcher and demanded 5 million naira ransom from his family.

Title: Kidnapper Vs Mob, Kogi
Description: A kidnapper, Ibrahim Yakubu, was lynched by some youths in a village. The incident happened when Yakubu and his accomplice, Wada Mustapha were trying to escape to their camp with a victim, Mrs Ocheje Mary, whom they kidnapped. While Yakubu died from the beating by the mob, Mustapha was rescued by a team of policemen in the area. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 4 kidnappers were shot dead when a team of policemen engaged them in a shootout. It was reported that the police were on a rescue operation of kidnapped victims when the gun duel ensued. The date of the incidents was not stated but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnap Victim, Imo
Description: Madam Ogo Omereji, was kidnapped, murdered and buried in a shallow grave by her abductors (Emeka Chinedu, Peter Obido, Gift Emeka and Sunday Uchenna) who happen to be her nephews. The shallow grave was discovered almost 3 months after a ransom was collected she was murdered.

Title: 5 Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 5 kidnappers were killed and 3 kidnapped victims were rescued within a period of 5 days.

Title: Kidnappers vs Israeli, FCT (Abuja)
Description: An Isreali National (name withheld) working with a construction company, GILMOR was killed by kidnappers in a community. While the Isreali was on his way to the construction site of the company, he was accosted by 4 young men who forced him out of his Toyota salon car and later killed him. Hassan Gimba was later arrested for the murder.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Kogi
Description: A gang of kidnappers shot a man named Ogbaele Obi to death while trying to abduct his sister-in-law. The date of the event is not stated but due to the nature of the story this event is backdated by 2 weeks.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: A kidnapper was gunned down during a gun battle between his gang and a team of policemen. A female kidnap victim was rescued from the kidnappers' hideout by the police.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: 3 kidnappers were killed during an exchange of fire with a team of policemen.The hoodlums kidnapped one Mrs. Paaga Blessing Emabari, who escaped before the police engaged the gang. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Kogi
Description: A kidnap kingpin, Aliyu Isa (aka Osama) was shot dead by policemen during a gun duel between them. The incident happened when Aliyu and his gang attacked an oil marketer and his workers at a filling station. The manager and one other staff of the filling station were killed. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Soldiers Vs Kidnapper, Abia
Description: A kidnapper was shot dead while two others, including a female kidnapper were arrested by soldiers. The incident happened when the soldiers stormed the hideout of the evil men who kidnapped a lady identified as Mrs Rita Anaekwe. Subsequent, another source reported that the alleged kidnapper was a soldier, Lt. B.N. Edim who was shot dead by his subordinates.

Title: Police Vs Hoodlums/Kidnappers, Imo
Description: 3 kidnappers were killed during a gun duel with policemen who stormed their den. The policemen tracked the kidnappers to their hideout in an uncompleted building and engaged them in a shoot out. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnappers vs Woman, Abia
Description: Mrs. Chioma Chukwura was abducted with her driver Ike Chikodi, who later escaped from the kidnappers. She was killed few days after her abduction and her corpse was dumped in a bush.

Title: Security Operatives Vs Kidnappers, Ondo
Description: 1 kidnapper was shot dead when a combined team of security operatives stormed the hideout of kidnapers, who abducted the regent of Akungba. The deceased was shot dead when he attempted to wrestle a gun from the security operatives after his arrest.

Title: Gunmen/Kidnappers Kill 1, Bayelsa
Description: A young man was killed by gunmen who kidnapped 3 women. The man was killed when he tried to foil the operation of a gang of kidnappers/gunmen.

Title: Kidnappers' Den, Edo
Description: The bones and ashes of a 67-year-old kidnap victim, Premie Eboigbe Ohakhena, was recovered by policemen. The deceased was killed by his abductors who linked him to the death of another man whom he had a land dispute with. His abduction and death were masterminded by a 53-year-old grandfather, Fred Ikhimu Arobi. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Enugu
Description: A notorious kidnapper was shot dead by the police during a gun duel. The kidnappers had attempted to abduct a Malaysian business man who had come home to develop his property. Since this incident was reported to have happened few days back, this event is backdated by 2 days from its report.

Title: Kidnapped Victim, Rivers
Description: Mr. Friday Ozogo was kidnapped and shot dead after his abductor collected the sum of N500, 0000 from him as a ransom. He was buried in a shallow grave around Choba waterfront.
Place: Eneka Farm Road in Port Harcourt.

Title: Kidnappers, Ondo
Description: An Ex-Vice Chancellor of Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA), Prof Albert Ilemobade was brutally murdered by his driver and guard. The deceased was kidnapped for about a week before his remains was found in a store in his home. He retired from FUTA in 1995 after serving two terms As VC.

Title: Kidnappers Kill Girl, Oyo
Description: An 11-year-old girl, Aminat Ishola was killed by 3 men who kidnapped her. The kidnappers were identified as Babatunde Aderonmu, Sina Damilare and Kola Taofeek. The deceased was a primary 5 pupil and died as a result of powdery substance administered on her by the kidnappers while in the custody.

Title: Police Vs Hoodlums/Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 4 notorious armed robbers and kidnappers were killed by policemen that stormed the gang's hideout. 4 of the hoodlums were shot dead by the police during a gun duel while a female member of the gang was arrested.

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 policemen were shot dead during a kidnap incident. The kidnappers who had successfully abducted a rice dealer ran into a police patrol van and opened fire on them. One of them died on the spot and the other later died from injuries sustained during the attack.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: A kidnapper was shot dead when police detectives bust a five-man kidnap gang that kidnapped a Catholic priest. The deceased was identified as Ibewuchi Uzo. Other members of the gang were Obinna, Celestine, Frank and Bush. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnappers, Ekiti
Description: An occupant of a commercial vehicle was shot dead in an attempt to kidnap one Mrs. Aladeneka, a nurse in a Federal Teaching Hospital.

Title: Police Vs Hoodlums/Kidnappers, Ogun
Description: A member of a kidnap gang, Niyi Omosola was killed when a team of police men engaged his gang in a gun duel following an attempt to rescue a kidnapped victim.The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Ekiti
Description: The driver of Dr. Femi Omisore, a lecturer at Obafemi Awolowo University, OAU, Ile-Ife, was killed by kidnappers as they tried to kidnap the lecturer. He was shot as he tried to escape from the evil men and succeeded in kidnapping his boss.

Title: Women Hostages vs Soldiers, Borno
Description: Women that were taken hostage by Boko haram insurgents opened fire on some soldiers that came to rescue them and killed 7. Dozens (at least 24) of the women were killed by the soldiers in the encounter. As reported, the event happened last week. This event is therefore backdated by 7 days of its report.

Title: Kidnappers vs Policeman, Rivers
Description: A policeman was killed when kidnappers abducted one Eze Samuel Amaechi, the traditional ruler of Igbo-Agwurasa Kingdom.

Title: Police Vs Hoodlums/Kidnappers, Oyo
Description: 3 people were killed when police and irate youths clashed, following the discovery of kidnappers' den in a house in the area. While the youths killed a Divisional Police Officer (DPO) and the police men killed 2 youths.Unconfirmed report stated that a boy named Sodiq died when the youths set the kidnappers' house ablaze.

Title: Police vs Kidnapper, Lagos
Description: A kidnapper, Niyi Omosola, was shot dead by the police while picking a ransom for a kidnapped woman. The victim died in the hospital from gunshot injuries.

Title: Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: 5 kidnappers including their informant (Jude) were shot dead by a Special Anti-Robbery Squad.

Title: Kidnap vs Policemen, Kogi
Description: Kidnappers engaged security personnel in a gun battle and killed a policeman. This was the second kidnap incident involving Chinese expatriates within a week.

Title: Police vs Kidnapper, Ebonyi
Description: A kidnapper, in police uniform, was shot dead during a shootout between a gang kidnappers and policemen. The incident happened when the police men tried to rescue a kidnap victim who was abducted from his shop. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnapper Kingpin, Lagos
Description: Henry Chibueze, a kidnap kingpin was reported to have stormed his girlfriend's (Sandra Ijedinma) house and killed her, her elder sister and 2 kids. He also killed another Sandra's sister and her 3 children who lived in the same area. Henry is a notorious kidnapper who killed the 7 people in a day. He was said to have also kidnapped a British, Diction Lee among others in the past.

Title: JTF vs Kidnapper, Edo
Description: A kidnapper was killed in a shootout with JTF troops during a rescue mission. It is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported since the date of the incident was not reported.

Title: Kidnap Medical Doctor, Rivers
Description: Samuel Okpara, a medical doctor was kidnapped on February 18 from his hospital at D-Line area of Port Harcourt and was found dead in the hands of his abductors in another location. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.
Place: Behind Government Comprehensive Secondary school, Borokiri.

Title: Police Kill Kidnapper, Ondo
Description: A kidnapper was shot dead by the police during a kidnap incident. The victim died on the way to the hospital after he was shot during the kidnap of the wife of a traditional ruler.

Title: Police Versus Kidnappers, Edo
Description: Policemen killed 5 suspected kidnappers at 2 separate shoot-out.
Place: Kojo Road at Ikpoba-Hill and along Benin/Auchi by-pass.

Title: Kidnaper Kingpin, Lagos
Description: Police shot dead a kidnap gang leader, John Paul, in a gun duel that ensued while a hotel director was being rescued.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, FCT (Abuja)
Description: An elderly man was shot dead on his farm by fleeing kidnappers who had successfully kidnapped a Chinese rail worker.

Title: Abducted Businessman, Benue
Description: The corpse of a kidnapped businessman, Mr Edwin Okechukwu, the Managing Director of Our Choice Water Company, was recovered few days later. It is assumed that the victim was killed a day before his corpse was were recovered.

Title: Kidnapper, Abia
Description: The Soldiers of the 144 Battalion of the Nigerian Army, Asa, killed 2 kidnappers during an exchange of gunfire. 3 of the kidnappers escaped. The abducted victims, Mrs. Evans, and his son, Joseph, were lucky not to have paid the ransom being demanded by the kidnappers.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 3 kidnappers were shot dead by the police. The kidnappers were killed when the police invaded their hideout following a tip-off.

Title: Kidnapped Monarch's Wife, Ondo
Description: Olori Dupe, the wife of Oba Lamure Ayelomi of Ayeka, was found dead 10 days after she was kidnapped. The corpse was found at the spot where the kidnappers asked the family to bring the ransom. The date of the incident was not reported. However, based on the report it is assumed that it happened 2 days (2014-12-28) before it was reported on 2014-12-30.

Title: Kidnap, Bauchi
Description: 72-year-old Alhaji Baffa Tilde, the former Accountant General to the Bauchi State government, was abducted and killed by gunmen. He was killed in the process of negotiating a ransom for his release.

Title: Police Versus Kidnappers, Ogun
Description: 4 kidnappers were killed during fierce gun duel with Policemen.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Edo
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed during a shootout with the police. It is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported as the date of the incident was not reported.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: 3 kidnappers were shot dead by the police during a shootout. The kidnappers were intercepted while sharing their loot.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Lagos
Description: Steph and Akpofure, 2 gang members that kidnapped a female banker and kept her in the bush for 7 days were killed in gun duel with the police. This incident is backdated by 7 days since the shootout happened during the rescue operation on the 7th day.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: 1 armed kidnapper was shot dead by the police. A male teacher, Gabriel Oviere, who was kidnapped by the armed gang was rescued by the police. The date of the incident was not reported. However, based on the report it is assumed that the incident happened 2 days (2014-11-04) before it was reported on 2014-11-06.

Title: Police Kills Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: 5 kidnappers and one of their victims died during a police raid on their hideout. The kidnappers engaged the police in a shootout on sighting them.

Title: Kidnappers, Benue
Description: Mr. Christian Eze was kidnapped in his house and killed after a sum of N1 million ransom was collected from his family.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: A kidnapper was killed in a shootout with the police. This event occurred during a rescue effort for the kidnap of a teacher.

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 people, who were riding in a tricycle were hit by stray bullets during a kidnapping incident. They died on their way to the hospital.

Title: Kidnap, Rivers
Description: A Halliburton Oil Services, Mr. Bankole Orisanyan, was killed in his home by unknown gunmen.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Enugu
Description: 2 kidnap kingpins, Udochukwu and Onyebuchi, were killed by policemen. Both men had been on Police wanted trail for a long time for robbery and kidnapping.

Title: Kidnap Victim's Grave, Rivers
Description: Mr. Emeka Paulinus Ajukwara was kidnapped, killed and buried by his abductors that included Hassan Adamu, Abbas Musa and Musa Mohadiyi. His grave was discovered by the police months after his kidnap. It is assumed he was killed the day he was kidnapped.

Title: Kidnappers vs Businessman, Akwa Ibom
Description: Mr Chijioke, a businessman was abducted and murdered by a gang of kidnappers after collecting a sum of 15million naira ransom from his family members.

Title: Mob Vs Kidnapper, Kaduna
Description: A kidnapper identified as Muhammed Sani, who was a member of a kidnapping gang that has been terrorising a community, was killed by some villagers. The kidnapper was set ablaze by the angry villagers.

Title: Kidnap, Benue
Description: A businessman, Leonard Nwankwo, was kidnapped and killed when his family could not raise cash for the ransom demanded by his abductors.

Title: Police vs Robbers Kidnapper, Edo
Description: 2 members of a gang who specialized in armed robbery and kidnapping were shot dead by the police during an exchange of fire.

Title: Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: 87 years old, Chief Benson Ayerite Adigio-Eseni corpse was recovered from kidnapers after 17 days of kidnap.
Place: Kula, a border town between Rivers and Bayelsa on the Atlantic fringe.

Title: German kidnap, Adamawa
Description: A German teacher in a government-run technical training centre is kidnapped by suspected Boko Haram gunmen despite the intervention of 2 militiamen who are allegedly killed.
Place: Anguwan Faransa (French quarters), outskirts Gombi city

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: The police invaded a hideout of kidnappers to rescue some kidnapped persons and killed 3 suspects in the process.

Title: Security Agents vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 3 of the alleged killers of Abia state Commissioner for Agriculture, Dr Ken Nwosu (Ogbuonye Ogbonna, Uchegbu Ugochukwu and Oleka Chibueze) were killed during a shootout with security operatives. The victims kidnapped a NURTW boss but ran out of luck when they were traced to their hideout.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: Police rescued 34 children, believed to have been abducted by kidnappers. 2 suspected kidnappers were reported to have been killed in the process. Since the date was not stated, it is assumed that the event happened 2 days after it was reported.

Title: Kidnap, FCT (Abuja)
Description: A female school proprietress of Chelson Group of School, Mrs. Edith Chunedu, was kidnapped by his driver and his friends. She was murdered and buried in a bush. 4 people including Maxwel Ajukwu, Sunday Jacob, Solomon Amodu and Ali Angba have been arrested for the murder.

Title: Kidnap Kingpin, Abia
Description: Chigadi, a kidnap kingpin, was shot dead by the police. He was tracked down after recent kidnap incidents.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Edo
Description: 6 kidnappers were killed in their hideout. The kidnappers were killed during a gun battle with the policemen.

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: A 72-year old businessman was abducted and killed by gunmen after collecting a N1.7million ransom. The victim was found dead in a suburb area a day after the payment was made to the kidnappers. Since no specific date was reported, it is assumed he was killed the day the ransom was paid.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Edo
Description: 6 kidnappers were killed in their hideout. The kidnappers were killed during a gun battle with the policemen.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 kidnappers who had earlier kidnapped 2 people were shot dead by the police when their hideout was attacked.

Title: 3 Kidnappers, Ogun.
Description: Three suspected kidnappers were burnt to death by hoodlums. Their victims alerted the people around. The abductors were killed and set ablaze.

Title: Kidnappers Kill 1, Rivers
Description: Mr. Promise Elemah was kidnapped and killed by his 4 abductors after collecting a ransom from the family. Since no date was reported for this event, it was backdated by 7 days of its report.

Title: Kidnapping, Anambra
Description: In collaboration with 9 others, a serving councilor, Mr. Kingsley Chukwuka Eze kidnapped and killed an immediate past Commissioner of Science and Technology in Anambra State, Mr. Chike Okoli, after collecting the sum of N2 million ransom from his family. 2 other victims were also killed in similar circumstances. It is assumed this incident happened in the middle of the month of May since the exact date was reported.

Title: Kidnapping, Anambra
Description: A passer-by was shot dead by kidnappers. A woman and her child were also kidnapped in the incident.

Title: Kidnappers, Edo
Description: 5 suspected kidnappers were shot dead during a gun duel with the police.

Title: Kidnapper, Ekiti
Description: A suspected kidnapper arrested, was burnt to death by an angry mob.

Title: Kidnapper, Lagos
Description: A male kidnapper who attempted to abduct a 6-year-old boy was set ablaze by an angry mob.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 kidnappers, Chukwu Orji and Udechukwu Kwuoka, were shot dead during an encounter with the police. The gang was going for an operation when they met their Waterloo.

Title: Kidnap Suspect, Ondo
Description: Some aggrieved youths set ablaze a middle aged man suspected to be a lunatic for allegedly being in possession of 2 children.

Title: Kidnapper Dies, Osun
Description: A suspected kidnapper who was beaten by an angry mob died in the hospital while receiving treatment.

Title: Kidnapper Lynched, Lagos
Description: An elderly woman suspected to be a kidnapper was lynched and set ablaze by an angry mob.

Title: Youths Lynch Kidnappers, Osun
Description: 3 kidnappers were lynched death and set ablaze in different locations by youths. This followed a tip off by one of the victims, 2 of his colleagues were tracked down and killed as well. Residents have resorted to jungle justice since the discovery of an 'evil forest' in Oyo state.

Title: Mob vs Kidnapper, Ondo
Description: A female kidnapper was set ablaze by an angry mob. The kidnapper identified as Aya Baba, was known to be a lunatic before she was caught trying to kidnap a pupil.

Title: Kidnappers Lynched, Osun
Description: Residents lynched 2 kidnapper to deaths. 1 of the kidnappers was mobbed by youths and commercial motorcyclists, while the other was set ablaze in another location within the same area.

Title: Kidnap, Bayelsa (Offshore)
Description: Paul Seiblei, was shot by suspected pirates during the abduction of 3 Dutch nationals and 2 Nigerians, his body was later found floating on a river.

Title: Kidnappers Lynched, Oyo
Description: 2 kidnappers who attempted to abduct a 7-year-old girl, Anike Mufutau, were lynched to death. One of the kidnappers was identified as Lateef Gbadagesin, a former Councillor in the state.

Title: Kidnappers, Ogun
Description: 3 suspected kidnappers were killed and set ablaze. One Oluwole Elizabeth was rescued from the kidnappers’ vehicle.

Title: Kidnapper, Ogun
Description: Kazeem Akindele, a mentally ill man was lynched and killed by suspected 4 persons for attempting to kidnap a 19-year-old girl.

Title: Kidnapper Burnt, Kwara
Description: A woman suspected to be a specialist in kidnapping children was lynched and burnt to death by an angry mob. A similar event was also reported elsewhere in the state (IBD002549).
Place: Near Oyun River, on the way to the University of Ilorin Teaching Hospital.

Title: Mob vs Kidnapper, Kwara
Description: A female kidnapper was killed by an angry mob. This event is similar to events IBD002548 and IBD002549, where suspected female kidnappers were burnt to death.
Place: Oyun Bridge, along University of Illorin Teaching Hospital.

Title: Kidnappers, Edo
Description: 3 kidnappers, Brown Ogunbor, Monday and Mark, who attempted abducting a pregnant woman, Mrs Ehi were killed by a team of Police Anti-kidnapping Unit.
Place: Evbomoma Road, off Sapele Road, Benin.

Title: Kidnapper, Kwara
Description: A woman suspected to be kidnapper was lynched to death.

Title: Kidnap, Abia
Description: Chidera Agu, a tricycle operator, was shot dead by robbers who also made away with his tricycle.

Title: Abduction, Benue
Description: Solomon John and 7 other persons were on their way to a traditional marriage ceremony were abducted and killed by their abductors.

Title: Kidnap, Ebonyi
Description: The kidnapped former Coordinator of Okposi Development Centre, Ebonyi State, Hon. Ihebunandu Okorie, was found dead in a forest.

Title: Kidnap Case, Bauchi
Description: A 10-year-old girl, Hauwa'u Auwal, was hit by stray bullets during a gun duel between a joint team of policemen and members of a vigilance group on the one side and kidnappers on the other side. The victim later died in the hospital.

Title: Kidnapper, Imo
Description: A team of policemen shot a 24-year-old notorious kidnapper, Samuel dead. The victim had been operating with his team of abductors from Lagos before he met his Waterloo.
Place: Works Layout, off Imo State University, Owerri Junction, Okigwe road, Owerri.

Title: Kidnappers, Kano
Description: Kidnappers killed a 5 year-old school boy despite the payment of a sum of N2 million ransom by his parents.

Title: Kidnap Incident, Abia
Description: Mr. Ifenkwe Matthew was shot dead by a gang of kidnappers for resisting abduction.

Title: Kidnap Suspect, Abia
Description: 2 suspected kidnappers, Reuben Okezie and Lekwa Uzor were shot dead by the police while trying to escape.The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Kidnapped Woman, Anambra
Description: 89-year-old woman, Adafor Madueke, who was kidnapped by her grand choldren, died one week after she was rescued from the kidnappers' den. The woman died due to her ordeal in the custody of the kidnappers. The date of the incident was not reported. But based on the report, it is assumed she died 2 days (2014-02-04) before it was reported on 2014-02-06.

Title: Kidnappers, Ondo
Description: 1 person, Olajide, was shot dead when 2 foreigners working with a construction Company were abducted by four armed men.

Title: Abducted Boy, Rivers
Description: An 8-year-old boy, Saint Brown, died after he was abducted by kidnappers. The date of the incident was not reported. But based on the report, it is assumed that the event happened 1 week (2014-02-02) before it was reported on 2014-02-09.

Title: Notorious Kidnapper, Enugu
Description: Operatives of the Enugu State Police Command shot a suspected notorious kidnapper who was alleged to have participated in the murder of former Kwara State police commissioner, Mr Chinwike Asadu. In a bid to revive the suspect; he was rushed to the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital, where he later dead. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed it happened 2 days before it was reported.

Title: Police Kills 2 Kidnappers, Kogi
Description: 2 members of a criminal and kidnapping gang led by Kabiru Bala were killed by the police during a fierce gun battle. The attack came as the police was invistigating a murder case during a marriage ceremony (see IBD001585 and IBD001855). However, this event is backdated by 7 days according to the report.

Title: Police Kills Kidnap Suspects, Delta
Description: A team of police anti kidnapping squad killed 3 kidnappers, who abducted one Ranger Okafor.

Title: Police Kills 4 Kidnappers, Delta
Description: 4 suspected kidnappers were killed by a team of policemen during a crossfire. Ebi Ngboroko, John Lahuru, Emmanuel Omorege, and Rufus Tamaraini were killed near their camp during the crossfire. The date of the incident was not given, but from the report it appears it happened 2 days before it was reported on 2013-12-27. It is, therefore, assumed it happened on 2013-12-25.

Title: Police Kills 4 Kidnappers, Delta
Description: 4 suspected kidnappers were killed by a team of policemen during a crossfire. Ebi Ngboroko, John Lahuru, Emmanuel Omorege, and Rufus Tamaraini were killed near their camp during the crossfire. The date of the incident was not given, but from the report it appears it happened 2 days before it was reported on 2013-12-27. It is, therefore, assumed it happened on 2013-12-25.

Title: Kidnapped Woman Dies, Anambra
Description: Mrs Maduake, a 90-year-old woman who was abducted by kidnappers died 8 days after her release. The old woman was said to have died of the shock arising from the kidnap.

Title: Kidnappers Kill Victim, Edo
Description: The abductors of a 43-year-old nurse, Bridget Osawaru killed her after collecting a ransom of N1.5m.
Place: Near Okhuahie Hill, Along Benin-Agbor Express-road.

Title: Kidnapping, Edo
Description: Dr. Sunday Eruzegbua was kidnapped and murdered by Archibong Savior, Ofeimu Luke, Okhualeigbe Ehikioya Ekanem Effiong Nyakno, Effiong Udoh Emmanuel and Monday Samson. Since no place of incident was reported, it is assumed the murder took place in Benin, the state capital.

Title: Kidnappers Kill Cleric, Rivers
Description: Seven people, including twins, were sentenced to death by hanging for the kidnapping and murder of Reverend Edwin Isaiah Dokubo-Harry. The cleric was lured to a forest where he was abducted and killed by Precious Jack Opara, Answer Dick, Osaki Fubara, Prince Mikado Philip, Tienabeso George, Seleipri Fubara, and Alaboeriya Fubara.

Title: Kidnapped Father, Anambra
Description: The decomposed and dismembered body of the late chief James Iloenyosi, father of an ex-Super Eagles player, who was kidnapped 3 days before his birthday was found in a bush in the month of February 2014. The victim was kidnapped and murdered by Ikechukwu Emilie.
Sources of information: The Punch (1 ) , The Nation (1 ) , This Day (1 )

Title: Kidnappers Kill Driver, Osun
Description: An industrialist, Dr. (Mrs.) Olayinka Obaleye, was kidnapped while her driver was shot dead in the process.

Title: Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: A 21-year-old Nonso Obukezie and Nnamekwu Uderike Sylvester kidnapped an old man in the bush for 6 days. The victim was later strangulated by his captors after collecting a sum of 1.2 million naira from him. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened middle of the given month, which was November 2013.

Title: Kidnapped Victim Dies, Kaduna
Description: A 17-year-old primary school pupil, Amir Aliyu, was kidnapped and killed by his cousin, Abba Aliyu. The suspects, Abba Aliyu, Nasiru Abubakar and Mohammed Danlami kidnapped the victim and gagged his month with a polythene bag, leading to his death.

Title: Kidnapper Kills, Edo
Description: The Chief Executive Officer of Thomas White Plc, Mr. Emmanuel Obiyan was reportedly shot dead by suspected gunmen while trying to kidnap Dr Onah Ekhomu. However, The Sun newspaper stated that the driver conveying Dr Ekhomu and his family to their home town was the only dead victim in the attempted kidnap.
Place: In front of Ambrose Ali University.

Title: Kidnap, Delta
Description: A gang of kidnappers led by one Nonso Obukezie and Nnamekwu Uderike Sylvester abducted a businessman and killed him after collecting a ransom from him. The victim's corpse was abandoned in the bush (see IBD002287). The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened in the middle of October 2013.

Title: Kidnappers Kill Boy, Kaduna
Description: A 7-year-old boy, Amar Baba, was kidnapped by his cousin and was killed a day after.

Title: Police, Army, Kidnap Suspect, Anambra
Description: A member of a kidnap gang was shot dead during a shoot-out with a combined team of policemen and army.

Title: Police Kills 6 Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: All members of a 6-man kidnap gang were killed by operatives of the Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS).

Title: Police Kill Kidnapper, Abia
Description: A member of a kidnap gang was killed by policemen during a gun duel.

Title: Police Kills Kidnapper, Delta
Description: Mr Rufus, the successor of a notorious kidnap kingpin (Kelvin) was killed in a gun duel with security operatives.

Title: Kidnappers Murder, Delta
Description: Two kidnappers were sentenced to death by the court for kidnapping and killing one Ifeanyi Akukalia after collecting a ransom of N2m for his release. The date of the event was not stated. Since the court process that led to the conviction of his killers must have taken a while, we assumed the event must have happened about 2 months before it was reported on 2013-12-24. Furthermore, since there is no clues about the location of the event, we adopted the place of the court proceeding as the place of event.

Title: Kidnap Suspect, Abia
Description: It was reported that about 10 suspected kidnappers have been killed in the past one month. About 4 deaths have been recorded by events IBD000858, IBD000771 and IBD000633 over the same period. We therefore recorded additional 6 deaths in this event to account for the total 10 deaths over the past 1 month. We have also adopted 30th of September as the date of the event.

Title: Police Kill Kidnappers, Abia
Description: A combined team of policemen shot dead 2 members of a kidnap gang.

Title: Kidnapped Octogenarian, Enugu
Description: The decomposed body of an 84 year-old Madam Adiza Ogbo, wife a traditional ruler, who was kidnapped by unknown gunmen was recovered from a shallow grave. There was no report on the date she died. Therefore, it was assumed that she died on the day she was kidnapped.

Title: Police Kill Kidnapper, Abia
Description: A kidnapper was shot dead by the police. The kidnapper was killed during a gun battle with a team of policemen.

Title: Kidnapped Victim Dies, Imo
Description: The bullet-riddled body of Mr. Kelechi Uchendu, a pharmacist, was found floating on a river. However, the date of the incident was not reported. We assumed it happened 2 days before it was reported on 2013-09-09.

Title: Kidnappers vs Police Officers, Lagos
Description: 2 police officers were shot dead by serial kidnapper, Chukwudumeme Onwuamadike known as Evans, and his accomplice, Joseph Ikenna Emeka. One of the officers was Chijioke Ngozi.

Title: Police Kill Kidnap Kingpin, Enugu
Description: Obiora Agbo, a suspected kidnap kingpin was killed by Police.

Title: Kidnappers Kill 4 Policemen, Edo
Description: 4 policemen were killed by a gang of kidnappers who abducted a renown human rights activist, Mr. Mike Ozekhome. The police patrol team was ambushed by the kidnappers who opened fire on them and killed 4 policemen during the exchange of fire.
Place: Ehor, near Ekpoma, along Benin-Auchi express way.

Title: Kidnappers Kill Police Sergeant, Delta
Description: Emeka Azolobi, a police sergeant attached to a Special Anti-Kidnapping Unit, was shot dead by a five-man gang of kidnappers. The police clashed with the kidnappers in an attempt to rescue 6 persons abducted by the gang.

Title: Kidnapper Ablaze, Kwara
Description: A middle-aged man who feigned insane but suspected to be a kidnapper was set ablaze by a mob.

Title: Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: A Nigerian was drowned, while trying to escape from kidnappers.

Title: Man Abducted by Friend, Benue
Description: A 39-year-old father of 3, Tartseagh Boshien was kidnapped and killed by a group of people led by his friend. He was waylaid at gunpoint and forced to drink a poisonous substance. The report was not specific about the actual date the incidence occurred but confirmed that it happened in the preceding weekend. We decided to adopt (2013-07-20)

Title: Kidnapped, Anambra
Description: 52-year-old Azubuike Okoye, was kidnapped on a Wednesday and was reported dead on Thursday as a result of bleeding from the gunshot injury he sustained during the incidence.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: A fatal encounter between a team of policemen and a gang of kidnappers led to the death of 3 of the kidnappers. 7 others were arrested by the police in connection with the crime.

Title: Kidnap victim, Enugu
Description: Suspected kidnappers arrested by police in connection with the abduction and murder of Ijeoma Maduabuchi. This incident was backdated by 2 days since no date was reported.

Title: Kidnapper, Police, Ogun
Description: A kidnapper was killed during an exchange of gun fire between him and men of the Ogun State police command. The incidence occurred after his gang kidnapped 2 Chinese, Song Jiang She and Zhang Wen Xue.
Place: Shotunbo, Kilometre 3, off Sagamu, Ikorodu road.

Title: SARS Kills Kidnapper, Ebonyi
Description: Operatives of the Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS) of the police killed a member of kidnappers, and rescue the wife of the Deputy Leader of Ebonyi State House of Assembly, Mrs. Winifred Ogbu, from her abductors.

Title: Police kill kidnappers, Ogun
Description: After 72 hours of ambush, the Special Anti-Robbery Squad of the Lagos State Police Command led by Abba Kyari killed 7 kiddnappers, arrested two and recovered 4 AK47 rifles, 28 AK47 magazines and over 1000 rounds of live ammunitions. The arrest came after a tip off on the kidnapping of an Indian.

Title: Kidnap and Drown, Rivers
Description: Godspower Ekpe and his 5-men gang kidnapped and threw Achonye into a river after withdrawing the sum of 750,000 naira from him.

Title: Police kill 2 kidnappers, Delta
Description: 2 kidnappers are killed, 8 hostage takers are arrested, including 3 women, in separate gun battles with two kidnap gangs. There are possibilities the real date of the event is not the one given below, as the article stays quite vague on it. One may consider it the event happens between the 9th and the 14th of May.

Title: Policemen Kills Kidnappers, Lagos
Description: Jonah Osinachi, aka China and 7 others were killed by SARS operatives in connection with the kidnapping of Chairman of a local government development area. The report stated that the event happened 4 months ago when SARS operatives made the first arrest. Since it is 4 months ago, We assume the event happened on 2013-06-17

Title: Guard shot dead during kidnapping, Ebonyi
Description: A consultant pediatrician, Dr. Pius Chuka Manyaike, is kidnapped by unknown gunmen. His security man is shot dead by the kidnappers when he tries to prevent them from gaining entry into the hospital.

Title: Kidnapper killed by police, Delta
Description: A group of kidnapper is attacked by the police, and one dies, while trying to flee. A victim is rescued, and many weapons are recovered from the building the police destroy.

Title: Boko Haram kidnaps and kills one policeman, Borno
Description: One policeman is kidnapped and killed. His remains are dumped the following day. He was attached to the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).

Title: Kidnapping, Kogi
Description: Mustapha was abducted in his home by kidnappers and later found dead inside a forest. This incident was reported to have happened in the first quater of last year, hence, this event is backdated to 30th April, 2013.

Title: Kidnapper killed, Ogun
Description: A 16-year-old pupil is found in a bush, and his kidnapper is killed by the police. Three other suspects are arrested.

Title: Kidnappers vs Police Officer, Lagos
Description: A serial kidnapper, Chukwudumeme Onwuamadike known as Evans, and his accomplice, Joseph Ikenna Emeka, reportedly killed a police officer, Peter Nwaeke. Both suspects have been in detention since their arrest by security operatives. They were involved in high-profile kidnap incidents and the killing of policemen. Also see the event in IBD031631.

Title: Kidnappers vs Police Officer, Lagos
Description: A serial kidnapper, Chukwudumeme Onwuamadike known as Evans, and his accomplice, Joseph Ikenna Emeka, reportedly killed a police officer, Peter Nwaeke. Both suspects have been in detention since their arrest by security operatives. They were involved in high-profile kidnap incidents and the killing of policemen. Also see the event in IBD031631.

Title: Kidnapper killed, Abia
Description: A kidnapper is killed during a gun battle with security operatives. Two others are arrested.

Title: Police vs Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: The police killed 3 kidnappers during an encounter. A team of policemen engaged the kidnappers in a gun battle following the kidnapping of a 65-year-old victim. The incident is related to event (IBD002290) which happened 2013-03-23. The date of the incident was not given. However, it is assumed that it happened 2 days (2013-03-25) after event (IBD002290) which occurred 2013-03-23.

Title: Kidnap, Anambra
Description: A man was abducted by a gang of kidnappers led by Nonso Obukezie and Nnamekwu Uderike Sylvester. The victim was killed after some amount of money was paid as ransom. Also see IBD002287; IBD002287. The date of the incident was not given but it is assumed that it happened a year before it was reported.

Title: Lawmaker kidnapped, killed after ransom paid, Imo
Description: kidnapped ex lawmaker and former majority leader of Imo State House of Assembly (Dan Nwagwu) is killed after family pays N5m ransom. He had been kidnapped in January 2013 in Abai.

Title: Gunmen attempt to kidnap a female Lebanese, Lagos
Description: A police corporal (Levi) is killed as gunmen attempt to kidnap a lebanese who owns a sharwama joint called Delic.

Title: French hostages, Borno
Description: Scores of lives were lost in connection with the search of French hostages kidnapped by Boko Haram. Kidnapping in Cameroon, near WAZA animal park. Hostages brought to Nigeria by Boko Haram; hideouts burnt in Ummarari and Jajeri, suicide bomb at JTF van,Gamboru Customs road

Title: Kidnappers, Delta
Description: Mrs Patricia Amitaye, a staff of Delta State-owned The Pointer newspaper was kidnapped and her lifeless body later found in a bush. From the report, she must have died from shock and assault by the kidnappers.

Title: Kidnapper Kills 2 Chiefs, Delta
Description: A popular kidnapping kingpin, Kelvin Oniara and his gang killed 2 chiefs in a broad daylight for giving information about their operation to security operatives and for backing calls for the arrest their gang leader. The date of the incident was not given, but from the report it happened before the gang attacked a prison and killed 3 warders on 2013-03-13 (see PAR010966). Based on the report, we assumed it happened 2 weeks (2013-02-27) before the prison attack.

Title: Policemen killed, Hotel MD kidnappedl, Imo
Description: Gunmen in police uniforms attack Naija Plaza Hotel, killing two police constables during the raid. They kidnap the Managing Director of the hotel and cart away undisclosed amount of money.

Title: Police Vs Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: 3 suspected kidnappers were killed by a crack team of anti-kidnapping squad from Imo State police command. The police operatives trailed the hoodlums and killed them during a gun battle.

Title: Killing and abduction at AGIP oil site, Delta
Description: Unknown gunmen kill two policemen on escort and abduct four staff of Agip and Sterling companies.
Place: AGIP oil field located in Okpai/Beneku, Kwale
Protagonists: armed gangs, ENI, Independent oil companies, police

Title: Kidnapper, Imo
Description: Police kill a notorious kidnapper (Matthew Alaribe).

Title: Robbers, Kidnappers on rampage in Delta
Description: A gang of robbers mount a block near a filling station and attack travellers. Two policemen and a woman are killed, naval officers and naval commander injured.

Title: Kidnapping, death and ransom, Lagos
Description: A neighbour (Onyeka Patrick) strangles a child (Ayuba) to death, and asks ransom (N5 million). The suspect blames the devil for his act.
Place: Boy dumped in a pit, in an uncomplete building, Ikotun

Title: Kidnapped, Osun
Description: Mr Kola Adedeji, a top official of a federal parastatal in Abuja was kidnapped and thrown out of a moving car.

Title: Kidnapping in Edo
Description: Gunmen abduct an Estate surveyor, Dan Odiete, killing a police orderly and a girl, hit by a stray bullet.
Place: Office of the surveyor Akpakpava and 2nd East Circular roads, Benin city

Title: Kidnapping of two Lebanese, death of a Nigerian worker, Delta
Description: Two Lebanese and one Nigerian attached to Setraco Ng Ltd, a construction firm, are abdutced. A gunduel ensues between security and abductors: a worker, native of the community (Joseph Akpudi) is killed.

Title: Kidnappers Kills, Abia 5
Description: Mr. Samuel Kalu was kidnapped shortly after he arrived from Spain. He was later killed by Caesar and his gang. No date of incident was reported in December. Therefore, 15th of December was adopted for this event.

Title: Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: Police kill 14 kidnappers in a rescue operation of a Turkish national (Biram Karakus), staff of Rivigo company in Port Harcourt. The leader of the gang Bishop Nelly was an ex militant, who got amnesty.

Title: Kidnappers, human part traders, Zamfara
Description: Police kill two members of a gang of kidnappers, also trading human parts during a raid as they are busy to negotiate the sale of a five-year-old girl (between N500 000 and N1,000,000, delivery in Niger Republic). The child is rescued during the operation.
