Title: Abductee dies in kidnapper's den, Rivers
Description: One of the three persons abducted by unknown gunmen dies in the kidnappers’ den. The development comes just as the State Commissioner for Power, Augustine Wokocha is freed. The deceased (Richard Ihua-Maduenyi), a College director, dies following lack of medical attention. Ransom is paid before Wokocha, kidnapped on October 13, 2012, is freed.

Title: Businessman abducted and killed in Lagos
Description: A gang of robbers kidnap and kill a businessman, Odidi Nweze back from the USA, two days before. The parents of the victim pay N 1.2 m ransom.
Place: The victim is kidnapped at a pharmaceutical store, Oxpharm Specialties Ltd, Satellite Town. He is killed in an uncomplete building in Okota

Title: A businessman (Akinsanjo Akinlade) kidnapped and killed, Lagos
Description: A businessman (Akinsanjo Akinlade) is abducted and murdered. Three suspects (Ogbuesor Sadiq, Abdulwahab Mutairu and Adenola Lanre), now arrested, ransack their victim’s apartment and dispossess him of jewellery, laptop and other valuables. A ransom (N 200,000) was asked to his wife but suspicioulsly, she insisted to talk to her husband first. The killers killed the hostage as he attempted to escape. Before their arrestation, the gang was about to kidnap another person
Place: Body with machete cuts found dumped in Ogijo, a border town between Lagos and Ogun states

Title: Son dies pursuing father's kidnappers, Anambra
Description: A gang of kidnappers abduct a businessman (Amulunanma Egbunike). His son (Junior Egbunike) dies in a collision as pursuing the hoodlums.
Place: Close to their home in Onitsha Inland Town

Title: Police kill kidnappers, Edo
Description: During a car chase, after a hostage (Senior civil servant Benson Ojoto abducted earlier in Delta State) escapes, police kill four kidnappers.

Title: Kidnapped Businessman Found Dead, Osun
Description: Police found the decomposed corpse of a businessman, Idowu Obembe who was kidnapped by hoodlums. The deceased was recognised with the aid of the jeans trousers and sandals he wore the day he was kidnapped. The report could not establish the exact date the deceased died, hence we choosed the date he was kidnapped.

Title: 3 notorious kidnappers shot by police, Rivers
Description: Three kidnappers (Nzeribe, alias Nze, former second in command to late notorious Osisikankwu, Samuel, alias ND and Chima,) who rob and kill are shot by police. Among their numerous exactions, are the kidnap and murder of Ambassador Ignatius Ajuru and his escort personnel (see event 5562), the killing of Hyacinth Nwangolo, former Rivers State Deputy Director and Head of Eco Service Department (see event 7139). Arrested, they are shot as they jumped from a Police patrol vehicle.
Place: arrested by Aluu Special Police checkpoint in yet another attempt to kidnap a man

Title: Police kill kidnappers, Delta
Description: Police kill kidnappers who earlier seize a staff of Chevron Nigeria Limited along Refinery Road, Effurun ( Amadi Chinedu).
Place: The kidnappers are trailed to Eku and eventually killed

Title: Anti-kidnap unit kill one abductor, free victim, Rivers
Description: Swift Operations Squad and anti-kidnap unit kill a kidnapper in a shoot out and rescue a victim. The gang abducted one Felix, a retired staff of the NNPC who was driving home.
Place: Felix was driving to Rumadara area.Police pursues the gang towards Aluu Road. Other gang members flee towards the ex-militants training camp (in Aluu) , Port Harcourt, and abandon their victim.

Title: Kidnapper killed by police, Edo
Description: Police kills a man involved in the kidnapping of a female lawyer. The lawyer has been freed after the payment of N1 million ransom.

Title: Police corporal killed by kidnappers, Delta
Description: Kidnappers dressed in NYSC uniforms kill a police corporal in a gunbattle during the rescue operation of a teenager (Emma Okenze) and her father, staff of Due Pocess Office, Government House, Asaba (Duke Ozeke).

Title: PDP chief kidnapped and killed, Kogi
Description: A PDP chief (Prince Raphael Aliyu Olorunpomi) is kidnapped in Kabba and is found killed several days after in a bush. It is alleged that he defiled the tradition of the land by opening a beer parlor during Oro Festival.
Place: his body is found in a bush along Okehi-Kabba road

Title: Staff of FCE abducted and killed, Kogi
Description: A bursary member of staff of FCE (Stephen Omole) is murdered by robbers. Having no money, he offers his car but the robbers, angry, abduct and kill him. His corpse is dumped inside a car.
Place: Federal College of Education (FCE). His corpse is found in a bush

Title: Kidnappers Kill, Abia 4
Description: Prince Iroeke and 2 of his security guards were killed by Caesar and his gang.

Title: Kidnappers killed, Football star freed, Delta
Description: Police rescue two pesons (Timiagi Onoriode a football star, and Janny Ogbaide) abducted by different gangs. Three Kidnappers are killed by police forces.

Title: Police kill kidnappers, free one in Delta
Description: Police rescue a kidnappee (Martins Denedo), Treasurer of the Senior Staff Association of Nigeria University SSANU. During the operation 3 kidnappers are killed, 3 others arrested. The leader of a vigilance group, (Nelson Denedo), invlolved in the crime is shot dead.
Place: SSANU Senior Staff Association of Nigeria Universities, at Eboh-Orogun. The victim was kidnapped on 1st January after New Year Midnignt service in Abraka

Title: Police kill kidnapper leader, Delta
Description: Police kill the leader of a kidnapping gang (Nwazor Nwose, Bolaji) who abduct the mother (Prof Kamena Okonjo) of Minister of Finance (Ngozi Okonjo Iweala). The victim, freed during the shootout with police, is the wife of the Obi of Owashi Uku in Aniocha South LGA (Prof Chukwuka Okonjo).

Title: Two Kidnappers, Lagos
Description: Two kidnappers, Philip Tomi and Joel Wolomo were reported to have been killed in police custody.

Title: Hotelier abducted, policeman killed in Edo
Description: A generator merchant, hotelier (Uyi Oloton) popularly called Uyi technical, is abducted. During the operation, one of his police orderly is killed.

Title: Kidnapper, Rivers
Description: Police kill a kidnapper and rescue his victim, a Port Harcourt based business man Otumba. The N 3 million ransom is recovered.

Title: Kidnappers vs Man, Rivers
Description: A former director of finance in the River State Ministry of Health, Charles Nwogu, was abducted from his home by some kidnappers who later murdered him. The kidnappers were identified as Andy Clement, Goddfrey Hanson and Chima Nwokoma.

Title: Man kidnapped and killed after payment of ransom, Ebonyi
Description: A businessman (Godwin Nwosu) is killed by kidnappers after payment of ransom from his family. He was the chief executive officer of Godal Pharmacy.

Title: Two nigerian killed, French engineer abducted, Katsina
Description: 30 heavily armed men of Ansaru group storm the residence of expatriates, contractors of Vergnet SA, (French renewable energy company). A neighbor and security guard are killed as a French engineer (Francis Collomb) is kidnapped. When they flee the kidnappers bomb the police station. According to Francis Collomp, 2 policemen and 1 fifteen years old boys are actually killed by the group. Francis Collomb will manage to escape on his own. See: Collomp, Francis [2015], L’évasion, Paris, XO éditions, 302p.
Place: Rimi is 25 km from Katsina. Vergnet is working on a wind project in Katsina
Sources of information: Sun (2 ) , Vanguard (2 ) , Daily Champion (2 ) , Other source (private security firms, etc) (3 )

Title: Kidnappers kill SSS, Edo
Description: An officer attached to Edo State Command of the SSS is killed during a rescue mission.
Place: around Lucky Way, Ikpoba Hill, Benin

Title: Setraco soldier, Lebanese abducted in Delta
Description: Gunmen abduct a Lebanese national attached to a road construction firm (SETRACO Nigeria Ltd) and kill a soldier attached to the company.

Title: Kidnappers of banker, Osun
Description: Police kill two kidnappers of a banker, Adeyemi Adeniji. Several members of the gang are arrested and the banker still abducted.
Place: kidnapped in front of his house in Ile Ife
LGA: Ife Central, Ife East, Ife North, Ife South

Title: JTF kill kidnappers, Delta
Description: Ikechukwu Aduba, Delta Commissioner of Police declares police kill four kidnappers in a retaliation attack, after the gang open fire in a drinking spot in Sapele (see event 9262).

Title: Kidnappers shot in Anambra
Description: Police kill three kidnappers and free an hostage (Jonathan Oneykwulu)

Title: Briton, Italian hostages, Sokoto (expatriates)
Description: On 7 March, army storm the hideouts of Boko Haram in Zaria and arrest Abu Mohammed, one leader of Boko Haram faction splinter faction (Jamaatu Ahlil Sunna Lidawati wal Jihad, calling itself Al Qaeda) while they are holding a Shura Council (the sect's highest decision making body). The sect leader dies following bullets injuries two days later, allegedly in SSS custody. Five sect members are arrested and an SSS operative, shot in the crossfire, dies from injuries. Abu Mohammed masterminded the kidnapping of two expatriates, a Briton (Chris Mc Manus) and an Italian (Fanco Lamolina) abducted in Birnin Kebbi on 12 may 2011. Despite information Abu Mohammed gave, the hostages are killed by their captors during the rescue operation organised by United Kingdom and Nigeria special forces (Army, SSS.The kidnap was kept secret by both governments. The hostages were engineers for an Italian construction company. In August, the kidnappers who release a video to a Mauritanian press agency showing one hostage, pretend the governments did not answer their demands. The kidnappers were under instruction to kill the hostages as soon as army was around their hideout. Abu Mohammed, linked to Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM). Eight of the kidnappers were reportedly shot dead and eight others captured.
Place: Hostages killed at Mabera area, near eastern bypass, in the suburbs of Sokoto. Hideouts of Boko Haram in Layin Hanwa area (Zaria, Kaduna). B. Stabilini Visioni construction company, Nigeria Ltd, was engaged in the construction of the Kebbi branch of the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN
Protagonists: islamic groups, other companies, army, armed gangs, other governmental security forces

Title: JTF vs Kidnappers, Delta
Description: A kidnapper was killed by members of a JTF during a rescue operation of an abducted victim. It is assumed that the event happened 2 days before it was reported since the date of the incident was not reported.

Title: Kidnap, Imo
Description: 3 members of a family were kidnapped and killed by by a notorious armed robber/kidnapper, Henry Chibueze aka Vampire and his gang after collecting ransom. This event is backdated by a year since no date was reported in the source. Also, see events in IBD010647, IBD004814 and IBD004816.

Title: Kidnappers Kill, Abia 2
Description: A 79-year-old woman, Mrs. Martha Oyediya Kalu was kidnapped and yet to be seen since 2012. This event assumes she must have been killed since no contact has been established with the victim since then.

Title: Kidnapper, Rivers
Description: Police of the State Command kill a kidnapper after the abduction of a baby. The rescue operation is successful after the ransom is paid (N600,000).

Title: Kidnapped German dies in Kano (expatriate)
Description: A German (Raupach Fritz Edgar) kidnapped in January, is killed by his captors during the rescue operation.The captors, members of the Sura Council where holding their meeting (the highest decision making organ of Boko Haram). The German is executed when the abductors notice the presence of JTF forces reportedly unaware of the presence of the expatriate, throwing IED on them. The victim was working with Dantata and Sawoe Construction Company Ltd before his abduction, on January 26. Six kidnappers are also killed in the raid.
Place: Danbare area opposite the new campus of Bayero University

Title: Kidnappers kill the daughter of a lawmaker, Anambra
Description: A five-men gang who tries to kidnap the wife (Vero) of a lawmaker, (Chief Anthony Ezechi nwoe) driving her Mercedes car, eventually kills her daughter (Chisom).

Title: Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: Police kill two suspected kidnappers.
Place: in their hideout at Rumuodomaya axis of the state

Title: Kidnappers, Anambra
Description: Police kill four kidnappers in a shoot-out and release he victim, a businessman who was abducted a day to his wedding, on April 15. Three accomplices have been arrested.

Title: Chairman dies in kidnappers' den, Anambra
Description: A former chairman of the Lagos State chapter of th Ohanaeze Ndigbo, Chief John Nzewi, a. k. a. Apunawu kidnapped a few weeks ago, dies in the kidnappers' den.

Title: Kidnappers, Delta
Description: Operatives of the Delta State Police Command kill two kidnap suspects after a gunduel.

Title: Kidnapper killed, Rivers
Description: After collecting a ransom from a victim, nine kidnappers are arrested and one is killed during a gun battle with soldiers.

Title: Two deaths, abduction as ACN member attacked, Edo

Title: Kidnap/Ritual Killing, Abia
Description: 2 children of Samuel Nwaigwe were kidnapped, killed and their vital organs harvested by their killers. The man's friend, Ebere, instigated the crime. The incident happened in 2009. Since no day was stated, it is assumed it occurred on June 30th.

Title: Kidnappers, Kogi
Description: Police killed one member of a gang of kidnappers who earlier abducted a 3-years old boy, Ibrahim Kokori, son of former State Secretary of PDP, Abdul Kokori

Title: Kidnappers kill 2 siblings, Akwa Ibom
Description: The Okon Ekpenyong family lost Emmanuel, 53 and Matthias, 47 killed by kidnappers as they were busy at work

Title: Police shot kidnappers in Rivers
Description: State Police Command killed kidnappers in a gun duel, while they attemped to move their victim, a medical doctor, to their den in the creeks, through the waterfront
Place: at the Njemanze Waterfront, Mile One, Diobu

Title: Fatal kidnapping, Abia
Description: Eshi, the traditional ruler of Nkwerre, Imo State, was killed by a gang trying to seize him while his car was used to kidnap another traditional ruler, the Udi I of Mbutu, Umuojima
Place: Eshi was on his way to Aba city when he was ambushed by the kidnappers.

Title: Abduction, Abia
Description: A bank manager, abducted on 09 March from his residence, has been rescued by police. One of the suspects, arrested, who tried to escape from prison custody, has been shot dead by police
Place: rescued from the hideouts of the gang at Ngada Umuelem village, Isuochi community

Title: Notorious kidnapper, Abia
Description: Police killed a notorious killer and kidnapper, Chin Chung, after he got a ransom from the relative of a kidnapped victim. Chin Chung killed a bank manager some days before his death (see event 4847)

Title: Suspected kidnappers, Anambra
Description: Suspected kidnappers have been killed by State police command

Title: Gunmen abduct Briton, kill his guard, Rivers
Description: Armed men have abducted a Briton who was having a drink at Edosa hotel along the East-West Road in Port Harcourt and killed at least one of his bodyguards. Allan Priston is 60 year-old, working with Adamac, an indigenous oil servicing firm

Title: Police kill three abductors, Enugu
Description: Police killed a gang who abducted Jennifer, wife of the Chairman of Enugu South Local Council, Sam Ngene. Jennifer was released after a ransom was paid but policemen stormed the hideouts of the gang, killing 3 of them. All the suspects, including the dead, were members of the Black Axe secret cult
Place: hideouts at Oji River and Ezeagu Local Councils
Protagonists: cult societies, armed gangs, other companies, police

Title: Rescue operation from kidnapping, Bayelsa
Description: Police rescue Florentina, the mother of Senator Emmanuel Paulkner. During the operation, they kill one of the abductors.

Title: Kidnappers, Lagos
Description: Police gunned down suspected kidnappers when they rescued a lebanese abducted one week before in Ozumba Mbadiwe area.
Place: in the creeks of Victoria Island

Title: Kidnappers Kill, Abia 1
Description: A kidnap kingpin, Ndukwo Nwojo popularly called Caesar kidnapped and killed Mrs. Oyediya Udensi and her 12-year-old granddaughter.

Title: Businessman abducted and killed, Edo
Description: For refusing to pay N110m demanded from the managing director of God is Good Motors, a Benin City-based auto dealer has now been killed by his abductors.
Place: His body was found in Ekiadolor, a village some 10km away from Benin City

Place: repartition in one LGA. According to police boss, Jonathan Johnson, Obingwa, Obehie and Ugwunagbor are the notorious areas for kidnapping. He accuses residents of non cooperation with police.

Description: A young girl preventing kidnappers to take away her sister, working with a bank, is killed. The hoodlums abduct the pregnant woman.
Sources of information: Daily Champion (1 ) , Other source (private security firms, etc) (1 )

Title: Abductors, Rivers
Description: A Chief Superintendent of the Nigeria Customs, Comfort Enujeko attached to Onne Ports, has been kidnapped while two of her abductors were killed in a shootout with police.
Place: kidnapped by unknown gunmen at the Oginigba, Trans-Amadi area
Protagonists: armed gangs, other governmental security forces, police

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: Police invades the hideouts of a kidnapping gang and kills two hoodlums.

Title: Schoolboy abducted and released, Edo
Description: The son of the Chairman of Ovie South-West LGA, Hon Monday Aighobahi was abducted from his school. He was released three days later after his family had allegedly paid N10 million ransom demanded by the kid’s kidnappers. Five persons who attempted to foil the kidnap have been killed

Title: Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: Police killed 3 kidnappers who just abducted an oil worker who has been rescued

Title: Kidnapped medical doctor, Akwa Ibom
Description: The corpse of a kidnapped medical doctor, Justin Edet, is found while the negotiation for the ransom was still going on.
Place: Corpse dumped by the roadside in front of Akwa Ibom State Secretariat

Title: Kidnapped oil Workers, Delta
Description: Two oil workers of NPDC, Danjuma Bashir and Malabu Ahmad, members of PENGASSAN kidnapped since March 13 have been found dead after a disagreement with police at a checkpoint.
Place: in the bush off the road to Sapele town, Mosogar area
Sources of information: This Day (2 ) , Vanguard (2 ) , Sun (2 ) , Independent (2 ) , Other source (private security firms, etc) (2 )

Title: Kidnappers (2), Abia
Description: Police killed 6 persons suspected to have abducted a banker

Title: Kidnappers Kill 3, Kogi 1
Description: A kidnap gang led by Kabiru Bala invaded a community and killed 3 people. It is assumed that this event took place in the middle of the given month (November) since the exact date was not reported.

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 kidnappers were killed following information that they were planning to kidnap a bank.
Sources of information: Other source (private security firms, etc) (2 ) , This Day (2 )

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: Police State command killed three kidnappers before rescuing a 70-year old woman, Comfort Erondu in a hideout in Ugba UzoIyi Umuodochi, Nsulu in Isiala Ngwa North Council. 2 other kidnappers were killed following information that they were planning to kidnap a bank.

Title: Suspected kidnappers, Bayelsa
Description: JTF invaded a community, arrested 2 suspected kidnappers and killed one man who attempted to escape and who was not a militant

Title: Foreigners abducted, Abia
Description: Three British people and a Colombian, John Bennet, Kevin Gray, Martin Phillip and Fabien Sanchez, from a joint venture Netco Dietsmann atttached to Shell SPDC Afapp V1 Power Plant have been seized. One Nigerian police escort has been killed in the operation. No group claimed responsibility for the kidnapping and a ransom demand of 300 million Naira (USD 2 million) has been made. On 19 January the four men have been released.
Sources of information: Other source (private security firms, etc) (1 ) , Sun (1 )

Title: Kidnap, Delta
Description: Mrs Evelyn Chima was kidnapped and murdered by one Fidelix Edozie and his gang. The victim was abducted when she was excavating stones. This incident is backdated to the middle of September (15th) since no day was reported.

Title: Abduction, Rivers
Description: Gunmen abducted 8 expatriates from a major oil and gas platform; 2 security operatives were killed in the operation; Three of the expatriates are Russians, four Lithuanians and one Latvian, all employees of Global Gas and Refining Limited. This attack came 12 hours after 5 Russians have been kidnapped from a Swedish Marine carrier, Herkules, sub-contractor of SAIPEM, ENI
Place: at the Yellow Platform, Buoy 38/39 on an LPG tanker

Title: Nigerian killed, French abducted, Rivers
Description: Gunmen kill 2 Nigerian and abducted 2 French nationals, a captain and an engineer of Bourbon Absara vessel working for Addax Oil Nigerian Limited.

Title: Kidnappers, Abia
Description: 2 miscreants who kidnapped 2 women have been shot dead by police after informants gave tips

Title: Kidnappers, Rivers
Description: Police killed 4 people who attempted to kidnap a business mogul. An inspector of police died too

Title: Kidnappers, Imo
Description: Eagle Squad officers killed 2 kidnappers on their way to abduct the managing director of CODUC company at Urata housing complex.

Title: Abductors murder a baby, Imo
Description: A gang kidnapped a 2-years old girl and strangulated her as no ransom could be paid
Place: corpse of the child recovered in a bush at Umuoma Oddumara, Orodo

Title: Abduction and killing, Rivers
Description: 15 gunmen kidnapped Mr Festus MacPepple, the father of the oil magnate, Chairman of Adamac Industries, Henry MacPepple : the gateman has been killed in the operation

Title: Abduction, Rivers
Description: The son of an oil and gas firm Managing Director Chidi Nzerim, DMS Ltd, located in Onne Oil and Gas Free Zone has been abducted. The little boy was on his way to Brookstone International School. The driver of the car and a police aid have been killed during the abduction
Protagonists: police, armed gangs, Independent oil companies

Title: Kidnapper lynched, Lagos
Description: A man who kidnapped a 5-years child near his mother's shop has been caught and lynched to death by an angry mog

Title: PDP's wife abduction, Rivers
Description: Chief Lulu Briggs' wife has been abducted by 50 gunmen/militants, killing one security guard/policeman. Her daughter has been injured
Place: at her residence 17, Igbodo street old GRA

Title: Abduction, Rivers
Description: Gunmen/militants abducted a German expatriate on inspection mission for Julius Berger Company and shot dead 2 soldiers and a driver. Also, 2 children of a PDP politician from Etche have been kidnapped in Port-Harcourt

Place: On the motorcycle, on their way back to school

Description: Police killed a notorious kidnap gang leader, Ogechi alias Kingpin, on mission to rescue hostages

Title: Kidnappers, Delta
Description: JTF killed 3 suspected militants who kidnapped a Lebanese in Ekpan area of Effurun in Delta State

Title: Son of Shell worker abducted, sister killed in Rivers
Description: Gunmen kidnapped a nine-year-old kid, son of an employee of Shell-SPDC. His sister, 11 years, resisting taking the boy away has been shot dead.
Sources of information: The Nation (1 ) , Vanguard (1 ) , Daily Champion (1 ) , The Guardian (1 )

Title: Police kill 2 kidnappers, Imo
Description: 2 kidnappers who abducted an eighty-year-old man, Pa Maurice Uche, later rescued, have been killed by police. The gang among which a NNPC worker, put him in an ambulance to confuse the police and asked N5 million for his release.

Title: Robbers ransom traders, Kano
Description: A gang of 50 robbers raided a market, ransoming the traders. Several policemen and civilians died.
Place: Abubakar Rimi market, also called Ibo Road market, Sabon Gari area
Sources of information: Independent (5 ) , New Nigerian (4 ) , This Day (2 ) , The Nation (5 ) , Vanguard (5 ) , Daily Trust (3 ) , The Guardian (3 )

Title: Kidnapped pastor dies, Delta
Description: A pastor of the Faith Assembly Prophetic Ministry was abducted by a gang and buried alive

Title: Abducted young girl dies, Anambra
Description: A 17-year-old girl kidnapped in June 2007, died for her parents’ failure to provide the ransom demanded. It is suspected that colleagues of her mother at the PHCN were behind the kidnapping.
Place: Abducted 32, Egerton Road, near the Onitsha Main Market

Title: Abducted oil worker dies in kidnappers' custody, Bayelsa (expatriate)
Description: An expatriate died as his abductors were on way to free him following a proacted illness caught in the jungle ; he was a Syrian national working for Gocogipar Nig Ltd, a Port-Harcourt subcontractor for Agip

Title: United Nation coordinator's abduction, Enugu
Description: After the abduction of the coordinator of the UNDP, Uche Ani from his home, a manhut of gunmen was launched: 2 policemen were killed
LGA: Enugu South, Enugu North, Enugu East

Title: One hostage taker killed, 5 arrested, Delta/Edo
Description: A 7-man gang on abduction's mission went in gunbattle with NDFF and his leader Egbema One who kidnapped 4 american expatriates May 8, 2007. As NDFF is now cooperating with government, they tried to convice the gang to give up : one man of the gang was killed
Place: in the creek on the border of the two States

Title: Foiled kidnapping, Bayelsa/Rivers
Description: JTF, operation Restore Hope, foiled an attempt by mlitants to kidnap some Koreans working for an oil service company Daewo ; one of the militant was shot dead and 2 captured by soldiers
Place: At Mbiama, a border town between Bayelsa and Rivers
Protagonists: political groups, Independent oil companies, army

Title: Militants abduct 5 expatriates, Rivers
Description: Militants attack an oil-drilling rig kidnapping 5 people working for Lonestar, drilling for Shell (SPDC). A policeman was killed in the attack. MEND whose one-month truce is over dissociates from this incident
Protagonists: Shell, Independent oil companies, political groups, police

Title: MEND kidnapp in Bayelsa
Description: Militants kidnapp 6 expatriate oil workers. During the operation, 2 naval personnel, a sailor and 8 militants died
Place: Ogoibiri, at Chevron Nigeria Limited, located on the high sea off the Atlantic coast of the Nun River
Protagonists: political groups, armed gangs, ChevronTexaco, army

Title: Abduction's attempt in Rivers
Description: 2 riot policemen where shot by militants dressed in camouflage as they attempted to abduct 2 expatriates working for Macobia Nigeria International. 5 gunmen were also killed

Title: Militants abduct 10 Indians in Rivers
Description: 40 gunmen stormed the Staff quarters of Indorama EPCL and abducted 10 Indian people, including worker, managing staff, women and children. During a crossfire between militants and Mopol on guard, 2 Mopol were shot dead
Protagonists: armed gangs, Independent oil companies, police
Sources of information: Daily Champion (3 ) , The Guardian (2 ) , The Punch (2 ) , Vanguard (2 )

Title: Russians' abduction in Akwa Ibom
Description: Gunmen seized 6 Russians from ALSCON /UC RUSAL (Russa Aluminium) in their residential compound, after they exploded their appartment ; a Nigerian driver attached to Group Five firm was killed in the attack
Protagonists: armed gangs, political groups, other companies
